mcqs.keyword: Share of deaths due to NCDs
mcqs.question: According to Dr Vivek Singh of UNICEF India, what share of deaths in India is caused by non-communicable diseases (NCDs)?
mcqs.explanation: Non-communicable diseases cause 63% of deaths in India, according to Dr Vivek Singh of UNICEF India. The figure of 25–26% refers to the share of premature deaths among NCD deaths, while 8–10% relates to children with Type 1 diabetes and one-third to the SDG 3.4 reduction target.

mcqs.question: According to hospital data for 2020–2023, approximately what proportion of heart attack patients in India were below 40 years of age?
mcqs.explanation: Hospital data for 2020–2023 showed that approximately 50% of heart attack patients were under 40. The figures 25–26%, 63% and 8–10% relate to other health findings, not the age profile of these heart attack patients.
